A whitespace-only span opening a div does not indent the image after it into a code block

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown-wasm";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<p>P</p>\n<div>\n<span>    </span><img alt=\"A\" src=\"S\"/>\n</div>");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
